verdict.rationale: The evidence only indirectly points to a self-managed edition: it references 'Bitbucket Server or Data Center' and a 'Bitbucket Data Center license', but only in the context of migrating away to Bitbucket Cloud. Nothing describes installing, operating, or supporting Bitbucket on your own infrastructure. Private CI runners are a pipeline feature, not self-hosting of the core product, so they get no credit. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation that Data Center/Server is a supported self-hosted deployment, install and operations docs, current availability and support status, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: moves your code and users from Bitbucket Server or Data Center to Cloud
for the same user count and duration as your Bitbucket Data Center license
